component.name: ViiZeyMix
component.summary: A friendly VoiceMeeter-style mixer for PipeWire

description.p: ViiZeyMix combines PipeWire device discovery, source-to-bus routing, virtual mix buses, live meters, volume and gain controls, and native IntelliPan processing in one mixer interface.
Places native PipeWire helpers in an explicit AppImage executable directory and reports discovery failures.
Adds the full Qt XCB platform dependency set to AppImage builds.
Adds the EGL and Qt runtime libraries required by the AppImage build runner.
